collector.operation: capture whole sequence then select causal c/a at fixed positions; separately compute labels and per-position SAE codes

core.operation: load exact S7 module; call forward_intermediates(ids) with default masks

attention.is_causal: True when allowed is None; explicit alternate mask is lower triangular
attention.layer_norm: RMS normalization is over last/channel dimension, not sequence

sae.operation: encoder and TopK act independently on each position

qualification: Static source/provenance check, not a new LM truncation/perturbation forward check. Current loader-target model source hash is preserved; cache provenance and prior model identity are reused.
time_boundary: Input features visible by index126; no token127 or later included in X. Future labels use actual targets143..255 only as Y.
